people.name: Maria McCormic
people.snippet: A washer woman who owned the home at 124 Apple Street, believed to be Rebecca McCormic's family.

people.name: Isaac Riggs
people.snippet: Maria McCormic's son, a brickmaker living at 124 Apple Street with his wife and children.

people.name: Rebecca Lambsong
people.snippet: Matriarch and Underground Railroad leader who lived across the street from the McCormic family.

people.name: Joseph Wilson
people.snippet: Black Philadelphian who wrote Sketches of the Colored People (1841), on the shelf at Zoar.
